mathematics.assertion_tested: On six MC27 spherical compact equilibria, independently integrate the required Q=0 heat flux, compare its sign and pole with nonnegative Fourier conductivity, and quantify the minimum cooling power under prescribed homologous compression.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Double precision ODE/quadrature; exact analytic sign identities supplied in DERIVATION.md
mathematics.conventions: A=Delta_m=4*pi*G=1; theta=-1 for compression and +1 for expansion; isotropic kinetic second moment; no direct Q when deriving required flux; exterior EOS fixed to MC27 only for the conditional full-halo integral.
non_claims: No full kinetic PDE or transport evolution
No conductivity or radiation microphysics is derived
No universal obstruction to nonlocal or anisotropic transport
No selection of pressure amplitude or central density
